name: Figu@mate Isshuukango
original_name: ふぃぎゅ＠メイト 一週間後
source:
Keigo thinks that lovey-dovey relations with the magical girl Ifrina would continue forever, but one day magical girl takes her original figurine form. A formidable trial arises before Keigo if he wants to see Ifrina ever again...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
